titles.english: Zenless Zone Zero: If I Could Become Light
titles.native: 绝区零 若能化作光芒

description:
That light that illuminates and burns, only sketches the world's silhouette, never asking if anyone deserves to be illuminated.

"Even if it costs me everything in the end... I don't mind."

(Source: Zenless Zone Zero YouTube Channel, edited)
